home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u.haw: He Mea Hana no ka Hoʻomaopopo — ʻAʻole he Kumu no ka Hana ʻIno
home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u.mi: He Utaunga mō te Māramatanga — Ehara i te Take mō te Whanonga Kino
home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u.ty: Hoê Mea no te ʻIte — E ere i te faufaa no te little little ino
home.why-totem-astrology.h2.a-tool-for-u.sm: O se Meafaigaluega mo le Malamalama — E le o se Mau mo Amioga Leaga

home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-.haw: Aia ma ka puʻuwai o Totem Astrology ka manaʻolana: manaʻolana no ka hoʻomaopopo ʻana iā ʻoe iho, manaʻolana no ka hoʻomaopopo maikaʻi ma waena o nā hoa a me nā ʻohana, a me ka manaʻolana aia kekahi poʻe i waho e kūpono iā ʻoe e like me kou ʻano.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-.mi: Kei te ngākau o Totem Astrology te tūmanako: te tūmanako ki te mārama ake ki a koe anō, te tūmanako ki te māramatanga pai ake i waenga i ngā hoa me ngā mema whānau, me te tūmanako kei reira ētahi tāngata e rite ana ki a koe tonu.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-.ty: I roto i te ʻāʻau o Totem Astrology te turaʻa: te turaʻa no te ʻite papu iā ʻoe iho, te turaʻa no te ʻite maitai i rotopū i te mau hoa e te utuafare, e te turaʻa e vai ra te taata e au iā ʻoe mai to ʻoe huru.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.at-the-heart-.sm: I le loto o Totem Astrology o le faamoemoe: faamoemoe mo se malamalama manino iā oe lava, faamoemoe mo se malamalama lelei i le va o paʻaga ma tagata o le aiga, ma le faamoemoe o loʻo iai tagata e fetaui ma oe e pei ona e iai.

home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim.haw: Hāʻawi nā alakaʻi holoholona ʻehā iā mākou i kahi ʻōlelo like — kekahi mea abstract e hiki ai ke kuhikuhi i ka wā e paʻakikī ai ka wehewehe ʻana i ka mea e hana nei i loko. Ke hoʻāʻo nei kekahi Kekeko e hoʻopiʻi i ka Pipi hihiu i luna o ka lāʻau, hiki iā mākou ke kamaʻilio e pili ana i ka hakakā me ka ʻole o ka manaʻo pilikino. Hōʻailona nā holoholona i nā ʻano i loko a mākou e hana ai, a hoʻohui lākou iā mākou ma ka ʻōlelo aloha.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim.mi: Ka homai e ngā kaiārahi kararehe e whā he reo tūhono — he mea abstract hei tohu ina he uaua te whakaingoa i ngā mea o roto. Ina e ngana ana te Makimaki ki te whakapiki i te Pūru ki runga i te rākau, ka taea e tātou te kōrero mō te pakanga me te kore e tino whaiaro. He tohu ngā kararehe i ngā momo o roto e mahi nei tātou, ā, ka hono tātou ki te kupu aroha.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim.ty: Te horoʻa nei te mau aratai animala e maha i te hoê reo like — te hoê mea abstract e nehenehe e tāpaʻo i te taime e fifi ai te faataʻa i te mea e tupu i roto. Ia tapao te Maki i te Puaʻatoro ia piʻi i nia i te tumu rāʻau, e nehenehe tātou e parau no nia i te tamaʻi maoriʻi aita e manaʻo taatoʻa. Te faaite nei te mau animala i te mau huru i roto, e te faafāriʻi nei rātou iā tātou ma te reo aroha.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.the-four-anim.sm: E tuʻuina mai e taiala manu e fa se gagana faʻasoa — se mea abstract e mafai ona tatou tusi iai pe a faigata ona faʻaigoaina le mea o loʻo tupu i totonu. Pe a taumafai le Manuki e faʻaulu le Pafalo i luga o le laʻau, e mafai ona tatou talanoa e uiga i le feteʻenaʻiga e aunoa ma le lagona patino. O manu e faʻatusa i ituaiga o totonu tatou te galue ai, ma latou te faʻatasi ai i se gagana o le alofa.

home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too.haw: He mea hana kēia no ka hoʻomaopopo ʻana i kekahi i kekahi a me ka hāʻawi ʻana i ka lokomaikaʻi — ka lokomaikaʻi i hānau ʻia mai ka ʻike ʻana i ko mākou ʻokoʻa a me ka mahalo i nā ala like ʻole e neʻe ai nā kānaka ma ke ao. ʻAʻole ia he kumu no ka hana ʻino, a ʻaʻole ia he kumu e ʻae ai i ka hana ʻino a nā poʻe ʻē aʻe i ka wā e hana ʻia ai ka pōʻino. Ua manaʻo ʻia ʻo Totem Astrology e hoʻomālamalama, ʻaʻole e hoʻopaʻahao: aʻo mākou i ko mākou ʻokoʻa i hiki ai ke kū mai no mākou iho a no kekahi i kekahi me ka hoʻomanawanui nui aʻe, ʻaʻole ka liʻiliʻi o ke kuleana.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too.mi: He utaunga tēnei mō te māramatanga ki a tētahi ki a tētahi me te tuku aroha — he aroha i whānau mai i te mōhio ki ō tātou rerekētanga me te mihi ki ngā huarahi rerekē e neke ai ngā tāngata i te ao. Ehara tēnei i te take mō te whanonga kino, ā, ehara i te take hei whakaae i te whanonga kino a ētahi atu ina ka whara. I hangaia a Totem Astrology hei whakamārama, kaua hei herehere: ka ako tātou ki ō tātou rerekētanga kia taea ai te tū mō tātou anō me tētahi ki a tētahi me te manawanui nui ake, kaua te iti ake o te kawenga.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too.ty: E mea tauturu tēnei no te ʻite iā tātou iho e te horoʻa i te aroha — te aroha i fanauhia mai te ʻite i to tātou mau taa ê e te haamauruʻuraʻa i te mau huru taa ê e haere ai te taata i te ao. E ere ia i te faufaa no te little little ino, e e ere ia i te faufaa no te farii i te little little ino a te tahi atu ia tupu te ino. Ua faataahia te Totem Astrology no te faaʻite, e ere no te tāpūhi: te haʻapiʻi nei tātou i to tātou mau taa ê ia nehenehe tātou e tū no tātou iho e no te tahi atu ma te manawanui rahi aʻe, e ere te iti o te tiʻaraʻa.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.this-is-a-too.sm: O se meafaigaluega lenei mo le malamalama i le tasi ma le isi ma le tuʻuina atu o le alofa — alofa e fanau mai i le malamalama i o tatou eseesega ma le faʻaaloalo i auala eseese e savali ai tagata i le lalolagi. E le o se mau mo amioga leaga, ma e le o se mafuaʻaga e talia ai amioga leaga a isi pe a faia se manuʻa. Na faʻamoemoe Totem Astrology e faʻamalamalama, ae le o le falepuipui: tatou te aʻoaʻo pe a tatou eseese ina ia mafai ona tatou tulaʻi mo tatou lava ma le tasi ma le isi ma le onosaʻi sili atu, ae le o le itiiti o le tiute.

home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res.haw: E lawe i ka mea e kani ai, e waiho i ka mea ʻaʻole — a mai hoʻohana i kēia mau alakaʻi e kumu ai i ka hana ʻino, ka mālama ʻole, a i ʻole ka noho ʻana ma kahi ʻaʻole palekana. Hiki i ka manaʻolana a me nā palena ke noho i loko o ka lumi like.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res.mi: Tangohia ngā mea e pā ana, waiho i ngā mea kāore — ā, kaua e whakamahi i ēnei kaiārahi hei whakatika i te nanakia, te wareware, te noho rānei ki tētahi wāhi kāore e haumaru. Ka taea e te tūmanako me ngā rohe te noho i te rūma kotahi.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res.ty: A rave i te mea e au, a faarue i te mea e ere — e eiaha e faaohipa i teie mau aratai no te faatiahia i te little little ino, te haapaʻo ore, aore ra te faaea i te vāhi e ere i te paruru. E nehenehe te turaʻa e te mau ʻātiʻa e noho i te hoê piha.
home.why-totem-astrology.p.take-what-res.sm: Ave le mea e paʻi, tuʻu ese le mea e le — ma aua neʻi faʻaaogaina nei taiala e faʻamaonia ai le sauā, le le amanaʻia, pe nofo i se nofoaga e le saogalemu. E mafai ona nonofo faʻatasi le faamoemoe ma tuaoi i le potu e tasi.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan.haw: Ka ʻōlelo ma hope o kāu mau alakaʻi ʻehā — e ʻimi i kēlā me kēia papa, a laila e ʻike iā lākou a pau ma ka ʻaoʻao hoʻokahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan.mi: Te reo i muri i ō kaiārahi e whā — tūhuratia ia paparanga, kātahi ka kitea katoatia i te whārangi kotahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan.ty: Te reo i muri i to ʻoe e maha aratai — a hiʻo i te mau papa tātaʻitahi, e a ite ia rātou taatoa i nia i te hoê ʻāpī.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.the-lan.sm: O le gagana i tua atu o ou taiala e fa — suʻesuʻe vaega taʻitasi, ona vaʻai lea i latou uma i le itulau e tasi.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-.haw: ʻUhane, Noʻonoʻo, Naʻau, a me Kino — ʻehā hoa holoholona mai kāu makahiki, mahina, lā, a me hola hānau.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-.mi: Wairua, Hinengaro, Ngākau, me Tinana — e whā hoa kararehe nō tō tau, marama, rā, me te hāora whānau.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-.ty: Vārua, Manaʻo, ʻĀʻau, e te Tino — e maha hoa animala mai to ʻoe matahiti, ʻavaʻe, mahana, e te hora fanau.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.spirit-.sm: Agaga, Mafaufau, Loto, ma Tino — uo manu e fa mai lau tausaga, masina, aso, ma itula fanau.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w.haw: Wai, Lāʻau, Ahi, Honua, a me Metala — hoʻopaʻa kēlā me kēia māhele o kāu pou totem i kahi holoholona me kekahi o kēia mau ʻElima Mea, e hoʻohui ana i ke ʻano i kāu mau alakaʻi ʻUhane, Noʻonoʻo, Naʻau, a me Kino.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w.mi: Wai, Rākau, Ahi, Whenua, me Konganuku — ka hono ia wāhanga o tō pou totem i tētahi kararehe ki tētahi o ēnei Huānga e Rima, e tāpiri ana i te āhua ki ō kaiārahi Wairua, Hinengaro, Ngākau, me Tinana.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w.ty: Vai, Rāʻau, Auahi, Fenua, e te Metara — te tāpaʻo nei te mau tuhaa o to ʻoe pou totem i te animala e te hoê o teie pae mea, ma te tāpiri i te huru i to ʻoe mau aratai Vārua, Manaʻo, ʻĀʻau, e te Tino.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.water-w.sm: Vai, Laʻau, Afi, Lalolagi, ma Uamea — e faʻapaʻaga e vaega taʻitasi o lau pou totem se manu ma se tasi o nei Elemene e Lima, ma faʻaopoopo le lanu i ou taiala Agaga, Mafaufau, Loto, ma Tino.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to.haw: Lawe kēlā me kēia holoholona totem i ka polarity paʻa mai ka hoʻomaka — ʻIole lāʻau mau Yang, Pipi hihiu mau Yin, Tiger mau Yang, Pōpoki mau Yin, a pēlā aku.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to.mi: Ka kawe ia kararehe totem i te polarity ū mai te tīmatanga — Kiore rākau i ngā wā katoa Yang, Pūru i ngā wā katoa Yin, Taika i ngā wā katoa Yang, Ngeru i ngā wā katoa Yin, ā haere tonu.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to.ty: Te amo nei te animala totem tātaʻitahi i te polarity paari mai te haamataraʻa — ʻĪore rāʻau e Yang i te mau taime atoa, Puaʻatoro e Yin i te mau taime atoa, Tiga e Yang, Pīni e Yin, e te peê ra.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.each-to.sm: E ave e manu totem taʻitasi le polarity mautu mai le amataga — Isu maumau e Yang i taimi uma, Pafalo e Yin i taimi uma, Taika e Yang, Pusi e Yin, ma isi.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co.haw: Hoʻonohonoho nā waiwai kumu ʻehā i nā holoholona he ʻumikūmālua i nā huinakolu e wehewehe i ka mea a kēlā me kēia alakaʻi e mālama nui ai.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co.mi: Ka whakarite ngā uara matua e whā i ngā kararehe tekau mā rua ki ngā tapatoru e whakaahua ana i ngā mea e tino manaakitia ana e ia kaiārahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co.ty: Te faanohoraʻa nei te mau faufaa tumu e maha i te mau animala ahuru mā piti i te mau tapatoru e faataʻa i te mea e manaʻo nui te aratai tātaʻitahi.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.four-co.sm: E faʻatulaga e taua autū e fa manu e sefulu ma le lua i tafatolu e faʻamatala ai le mea e sili ona manaʻomia e taiala taʻitasi.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-.haw: I loko o kēlā me kēia Huinakolu Waiwai, pāʻani nā holoholona ʻekolu i kekahi o nā Kuleana Kapu ʻekolu: ke ʻImi, ke Kahuna, a i ʻole ke Aliʻi — ʻekolu ala like ʻole e hōʻike ai i ka waiwai kumu o ia huinakolu.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-.mi: I roto i ia Tapatoru Uara, ka purei ngā kararehe e toru i tētahi o ngā Tūranga Tapu e toru: te Kaitoro, te Matakite, te Ariki rānei — e toru huarahi rerekē hei whakatinana i te uara matua o tērā tapatoru.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-.ty: I roto i te tapatoru faufaa tātaʻitahi, te haʻuti nei te mau animala e toru i te hoê o te mau tiʻaraʻa moʻa e toru: te ʻimi, te tahuʻa, aore ra te ariʻi — e toru huru taa ê no te faatiʻa i te faufaa tumu o taua tapatoru.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.within-.sm: I totonu o Tafatolu Taua taʻitasi, e taʻalo manu e tolu i se tasi o Matafaioi Paia e tolu: le Saili, le Taulaitu, pe le Tupu — auala e tolu eseese e faʻatino ai le taua autū o lena tafatolu.

home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl.haw: He hoʻololi timezone maʻalahi i ka Manawa Nepal (NPT) ma mua o ka helu ʻana — he heleuma intuitive no ka heluhelu ʻana i nā kia lā a me hola.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl.mi: He nekehanga timezone ngāwari ki te Wā Nepal (NPT) i mua i te tātai — he punga māramahiko mō te pānui i ngā pou rā me hāora.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl.ty: Hoê tāui timezone maʻaʻa i te Taime Nepal (NPT) mamua i te tātaitai — hoê tumu intuitive no te taiʻo i te mau pou mahana e te hora.
home.how-totem-astrology-works.p.a-simpl.sm: O se suiga timezone faigofie i le Taimi Nepal (NPT) aʻo le faitau — o se taula intuitive mo le faitauina o pou aso ma itula.

home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan.haw: He Kipi i ke ʻAno a mākou e Hoʻomaopopo ai i kā mākou Pilina me nā Poʻe ʻĒ aʻe a me nā ʻAoʻao Hakakā Like ʻOle o loko o mākou
home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan.mi: He Hurihanga i te Āhua e Mārama ai Tātou ki ō Tātou Whanaungatanga ki Ētahi Atu me ngā Wāhanga Taupatupatu o roto i a Tātou
home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan.ty: Hoê Tamaʻi i te Huru e ʻIte ai Tātou i to Tātou Fāriʻiraʻa e te Mau Taa ê e te Mau Tuhaa Tamaʻi i Roto iā Tātou
home.h2.a-revolution-in-how-we-understan.sm: O se Suiga Tele i le Auala Tatou te Malamalama ai i a Tatou Sofuaʻaga ma Isi ma Vaega Eseese o Tatou Lava

home.p.untangle-the-complexities-of-life.haw: E wehe i nā paʻakikī o ke ola ma kēia ao hou digital ma ka hoʻohui hou ʻana me ke akeakamai kahiko o nā totem holoholona ʻehā kūʻokoʻa āu i hānau ʻia ai
home.p.untangle-the-complexities-of-life.mi: Wetewetehia ngā uauatanga o te ora i tēnei ao hou, digital mā te hono anō ki te mātauranga tawhito o ngā totem kararehe e whā motuhake i whānau mai koe
home.p.untangle-the-complexities-of-life.ty: A tatara i te mau fifi o te ora i teie ao āpi digital ma te faafāriʻi faahou i te paari tahito o te mau totem animala e maha taa ê i fanauhia oe
home.p.untangle-the-complexities-of-life.sm: Tatala le lavelave o le olaga i lenei lalolagi fou digital e ala i le toe fesootaʻi ma le poto anamua o totem manu e fa tulaga ese na e fanau mai ai

home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and.haw: E hālāwai me kāu mau alakaʻi totem ʻehā a e ʻike i nā kālena i loko āu i hānau ʻia e kaʻana like.
home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and.mi: Tūtaki ki ō kaiārahi totem e whā ka kitea ngā pūmanawa o roto i whānau mai koe hei tohatoha.
home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and.ty: A farerei i to ʻoe e maha aratai totem e a ite i te mau tālena i roto i fanauhia oe no te faaʻohipa.
home.p.meet-your-four-totem-guides-and.sm: Feiloaʻi ma ou taiala totem e fa ma suʻe meaalofa i totonu na e fanau e faʻasoa.

home.p.understand-the-totem-dynamics-bet.haw: E hoʻomaopopo i nā dynamics totem ma waena ou a me kahi hoa — ka hoihoi, ka hakakā, a me ke kumu like.
home.p.understand-the-totem-dynamics-bet.mi: Mārama ki ngā dynamika totem i waenga i a koe me tētahi hoa — te kūtoni, te pākaha, me te kaupapa tūhono.
home.p.understand-the-totem-dynamics-bet.ty: A ʻite i te mau dinamika totem i rotopū ia ʻoe e te hoa — te hinaʻaro, te tamaʻi, e te fānaʻoraʻa like.
home.p.understand-the-totem-dynamics-bet.sm: Malamalama i dynamika totem i le va o oe ma se paʻaga — toso, feteʻenaʻiga, ma le faʻamoemoe faʻasoa.

home.p.map-totem-patterns-across-your-fa.haw: E palapala i nā ʻano totem ma kāu ʻohana e hoʻōla i nā pōʻai kahiko a e hoʻoikaika i ka pilina.
home.p.map-totem-patterns-across-your-fa.mi: Maherehia ngā tauira totem puta noa i tō whānau hei whakaora i ngā porowhita tawhito me te whakakaha i te hononga.
home.p.map-totem-patterns-across-your-fa.ty: A mape i te mau huru totem i nia i to ʻoe utuafare no te faaora i te mau tāpura tahito e te haʻamaitai i te fāriʻiraʻa.
home.p.map-totem-patterns-across-your-fa.sm: Faʻafanua mamanu totem i lau aiga e faʻamalolo liʻo tuai ma faʻamalosia le fesootaʻiga.

home.p.align-your-work-and-ambitions-wit.haw: E hoʻopololei i kāu hana a me nā pahuhopu me kāu ikaika totem a me ka manawa e kākoʻo iā lākou.
home.p.align-your-work-and-ambitions-wit.mi: Whakahāngaihia āu mahi me ō whāinga ki ō kaha totem me te wā e tautoko ana i a rātou.
home.p.align-your-work-and-ambitions-wit.ty: A faaau i to ʻoe ʻōhipa e te mau fānaʻoraʻa e to ʻoe mau mana totem e te taime e tauturu ia rātou.
home.p.align-your-work-and-ambitions-wit.sm: Faʻafetaui lau galuega ma sini ma ou malosiaga totem ma le taimi e lagolago ai iā i latou.

home.p.find-the-people-and-opportunities.haw: E ʻimi i nā kānaka a me nā manawa kūpono e kūlike me kāu mau alakaʻi — nā hoaaloha, ke kaiāulu, a me nā hoʻomaka hou.
home.p.find-the-people-and-opportunities.mi: Kimihia ngā tāngata me ngā āheinga e ōrite ana ki ō kaiārahi — ngā hoa, te hapori, me ngā tīmatanga hou.
home.p.find-the-people-and-opportunities.ty: A imi i te taata e te mau fānaʻoraʻa e au i to ʻoe mau aratai — te mau hoa, te nūnaʻa, e te haamataraʻa āpi.
home.p.find-the-people-and-opportunities.sm: Saili tagata ma avanoa e fetaui ma ou taiala — uo, nuʻu, ma amataga fou.

home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem.haw: E koho komo me kāu mau holoholona totem ʻehā a e nānā i nā poʻe ʻē aʻe ma ka database lehulehu — i hoʻopaʻa ʻia e nā pilina Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, a i ʻole Mirror.
home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem.mi: Tīpako kia uru me ō kararehe totem e whā ka tirotiro i ētahi atu i te pātengi tūmatanui — e ōrite ana mā ngā hononga Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, Mirror rānei.
home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem.ty: A maiti no te tomo ma to ʻoe e maha animala totem e a hiʻo i te tahi atu i te database no te taata atoa — te faaauhia e te mau fāriʻiraʻa Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, aore ra Mirror.
home.p.opt-in-with-your-four-totem.sm: Filifili e auai ma ou manu totem e fa ma vaʻavaʻai isi i le database lautele — e fetaui i Rainbow, Shadow, Trine, pe Mirror fesootaiga.

home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g.haw: E ʻike i kāu mau alakaʻi holoholona totem ʻehā me ka manuahi — ʻUhane, Noʻonoʻo, Naʻau, a me Kino — mai kāu lā, manawa, a me kūlanakauhale hānau.
home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g.mi: Kimihia ō kaiārahi kararehe totem e whā mō te kore utu — Wairua, Hinengaro, Ngākau, me Tinana — mai tō rā, wā, me te tāone whānau.
home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g.ty: A ite i to ʻoe e maha aratai animala totem maoriʻi — Vārua, Manaʻo, ʻĀʻau, e te Tino — mai to ʻoe mahana, taime, e te ʻoire fanau.
home.p.discover-your-four-totem-animal-g.sm: Suʻe ou taiala manu totem e fa e fua — Faaleagaga, Mafaufau, Faalelagona, ma Faaletino — mai lau aso, taimi, ma aai fanau.

home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com.haw: Hahai kēlā me kēia kau i kahi kaʻina hana maʻalahi a ʻoluʻolu mai ka hoʻokaʻaʻike mua a hiki i ka hahai ʻana.
home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com.mi: Ka whai ia wātaka i tētahi hātepe mārama, pai mai te whakapā tuatahi ki te whaiwhai.
home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com.ty: Te haere nei te taime tātaʻitahi i te hoê huru maʻaʻa e te au mai te parau mua e tae noaʻtu i te haapaʻoraʻa.
home.p.every-session-follows-a-clear-com.sm: E mulimuli sauniga taʻitasi i se faiga manino ma faigofie mai le fesootaʻiga muamua i le mulimuli.

home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a.haw: E koho i kahi lawelawe a e hoʻouna i kahi memo me kāu lā, manawa, a me wahi hānau inā loaʻa iā ʻoe.
home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a.mi: Tīpakohia he ratonga ka tukua he karere me tō rā, wā, me te wāhi whānau mēnā kei a koe.
home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a.ty: A maiti i te hoê raveʻa e a pūpū i te hoê parau ma to ʻoe mahana, taime, e te vāhi fanau ia vai ia ʻoe.
home.p.choose-a-service-and-send-a.sm: Filifili se auaunaga ma auina se feʻau ma lau aso, taimi, ma nofoaga fanau pe a e iai.

home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book.haw: E hōʻoia mākou i nā kikoʻī a e kākau i kahi kau wikiō i ka manawa e hana ai nou.
home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book.mi: Ka whakau tātou i ngā taipitopito ka pukapuka he wātaka ataata i te wā e pai ana ki a koe.
home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book.ty: E faaʻite mātou i te mau taʻaʻē e a tāpaʻo i te hoê taime vitiō i te taime e au ia ʻoe.
home.p.we-ll-confirm-details-and-book.sm: Matou te faʻamaonia auiliiliga ma tusi se sauniga vitio i se taimi e galue mo oe.

home.p.a-focused-conversational-reading-.haw: He heluhelu kamaʻilio i kālele ʻia i kāu nīnau — i hoʻopaʻa ʻia nou e nānā hou.
home.p.a-focused-conversational-reading-.mi: He pānui kōrerorero e hāngai ana ki āu pātai — kua hopukina māu hei tiro anō.
home.p.a-focused-conversational-reading-.ty: Hoê taiʻoraʻa paraparau i faataahia i to ʻoe mau uira — ua haapaʻohia no ʻoe no te hiʻo faahou.
home.p.a-focused-conversational-reading-.sm: O se faitau talanoa e faʻatatau i au fesili — ua puʻeina mo oe e toe vaʻai.

home.p.receive-a-written-summary-and-opt.haw: E loaʻa iā ʻoe kahi hōʻuluʻulu i kākau ʻia a me ka hahai koho e hoʻohohonu i kou hoʻomaopopo i ka manawa.
home.p.receive-a-written-summary-and-opt.mi: Ka whiwhi koe i tētahi whakarāpopototanga tuhituhi me te whaiwhai kōwhiri hei whakahōhonu i tō māramatanga i te wā.
home.p.receive-a-written-summary-and-opt.ty: E farii oe i te hoê haʻapotoraʻa i pāpaʻihia e te haapaʻoraʻa i maiti no te faahohonu i to ʻoe ʻite i te taime.
home.p.receive-a-written-summary-and-opt.sm: E te mauaina se aotelega tusitusia ma le mulimuli filifilia e faʻaloloto lau malamalama i le taimi.

home.faq.p.animal-names-birth-times-comp.haw: Nā inoa holoholona, nā manawa hānau, ka compatibility, a me ke kumu e ʻike ʻokoʻa ai nā holoholona like i nā kānaka ʻelua.
home.faq.p.animal-names-birth-times-comp.mi: Ngā ingoa kararehe, ngā wā whānau, te compatibility, me te take e rerekē ai ngā kararehe ōrite i ngā tāngata e rua.
home.faq.p.animal-names-birth-times-comp.ty: Te mau iʻoa animala, te mau taime fanau, te compatibility, e te tumu e itehia ai te mau animala like i te taata e piti.
home.faq.p.animal-names-birth-times-comp.sm: Igoa manu, taimi fanau, compatibility, ma le mafuaʻaga e eseese ai manu tutusa i tagata e toʻalua.

home.p.whether-you-re-new-to-astrology.haw: Inā he hou ʻoe i ka astrology a i ʻole e hoʻohohonu ana i kahi hana i loaʻa, ʻo kāu ʻanuʻu mua he kamaʻilio.
home.p.whether-you-re-new-to-astrology.mi: Ahakoa he hou koe ki te astrology, e whakahōhonu ana rānei i tētahi mahi kua tīmata, ko tō hipanga tuatahi he kōrerorero.
home.p.whether-you-re-new-to-astrology.ty: Ia āpi oe i te astrology aore ra e faahohonu ana i te hoê faʻaʻohiparaʻa, to ʻoe haamataraʻa mua e te paraparau.
home.p.whether-you-re-new-to-astrology.sm: Pe e te fou i le astrology pe o loʻo e faʻalolotoina se faiga o loʻo iai, o lau laasaga muamua o se talanoaga.

page.about.p.from-the-four-pillars-of-de.haw: Mai ka Four Pillars of Destiny a hiki i kahi timezone Nepalese — ka moʻolelo o ke ʻano i ʻike ai ʻo Totem Astrology i kona wahi.
page.about.p.from-the-four-pillars-of-de.mi: Mai te Four Pillars of Destiny ki tētahi timezone Nepalese — te kōrero i pēhea ai a Totem Astrology i tino ū.
page.about.p.from-the-four-pillars-of-de.ty: Mai te Four Pillars of Destiny e tae noaʻtu i te timezone Nepalese — te aamu o te huru i papu ai te Totem Astrology.
page.about.p.from-the-four-pillars-of-de.sm: Mai le Four Pillars of Destiny i se timezone Nepalese — o le tala pe faʻapefea ona maua le nofoaga saʻo o Totem Astrology.

page.about.p.relationship-counselor-mult.haw: Kākāʻōlelo Pilina, Astrologer Multi-System, a me ka mea nāna i hana pilikino iā Totem Astrology
page.about.p.relationship-counselor-mult.mi: Kaitohutohu Whanaungatanga, Kaipānui Whetū Multi-System, me te Kaihanga Whaiaro o Totem Astrology
page.about.p.relationship-counselor-mult.ty: Te taata faaʻite fāriʻiraʻa, te Astrologer Multi-System, e te Taata i hamani i te Totem Astrology
page.about.p.relationship-counselor-mult.sm: Faufautua Sofuaʻaga, Astrologer Multi-System, ma le Foafoa Patino o Totem Astrology
